description: Turns a target someone has already committed to (a board plan, an annual plan, a contract) into a plan the team can measure: KPIs in three tiers with a guardrail for each, a baseline from real data, monthly pacing with lag and seasonality, and two or three channels chosen from how your ICP actually searches and buys. Writes context/goals/MMYY-scope.md and context/goals/measurement.md. It never invents the target. Triggers: "set our goals", "what are our KPIs", "revenue target and pacing", "which channels and what targets", "write the scope file", "are we on track". Run after /funnel-strategy. Not for designing funnel stages (use /funnel-strategy).
